subject: Science
stem: A stretched rubber band possesses which form of energy due to its deformation?
explanation: A stretched/deformed elastic object stores elastic potential energy, released as kinetic energy when it returns to its natural shape (e.g. a catapult).

subject: Science
stem: A solar photovoltaic (PV) cell converts sunlight directly into:

options.option_text: Mechanical energy directly, with no electricity involved

explanation: Photovoltaic cells convert light energy directly into electrical energy via the photovoltaic effect — the basis of solar power generation.
